items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: Yeah, I think it was Jim Robison playing the trombone.

ctx.x: You'll think of it later probably. Do you remember the trombone?

The trombone, let's see, who was the trombone? The trombone, it was, let's see, oh I think it was Jim, Jim Robison I think. Oh Jim? Yeah, I think it was Jim Robison playing the trombone. Yeah, I'm most sure it was Jim playing trombone.
Well that's most of them there except guitar, you remember a guitar player.
